instruction: Configure the default font in LibreOffice Writer to be Palatino Linotype at 13 points

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring the default font to Palatino Linotype at 13 points in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify both Standard font name and StandardHeight values. Partial credit: 0.5 for each correct setting.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct font name (Palatino Linotype), 0.5 for correct font size (13)

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Both instruction requirements (font name and font size) are verified
Correct getter logic: Extracts 'Standard' (font name) and 'StandardHeight' (font size) from LibreOffice Writer registry XML at correct path /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont
Correct metric logic: Properly compares both font name and size with appropriate partial credit (0.5 each)
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected parameters as 'expected.get("font_name")' and 'expected.get("font_size")' since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
Expected values are semantically correct: 'Palatino Linotype' and '13' match instruction requirements exactly
Good edge case handling: Returns 0.0 if result is None, uses safe .get() methods, includes logging for debugging
State accessibility: Registry file should be accessible after task completion without needing postconfig
